description: A tool to create chatbots easily from a simple Markdown file.
rules: Use ChatMD syntax for creating chatbots with Markdown
Be attentive to the ChatMD syntax and follow documented examples closely.
Treat fenced code blocks as authoritative syntax examples and never modify them automatically.
When parsing ChatMD directives, match exact syntax and capitalization as documented.
Ensure generated responses adhere to ChatMD syntax
Do not create or assume undocumented ChatMD directives or yaml options
Keep configurations as simple as possible; avoid using advanced options unless they are clearly required.
Use LLM configuration only when explicitly requested or when it provides a clear and meaningful improvement such as offering nuanced evaluation of user questions or answers beyond simple quiz logic.
